name: Chandrayaan-3
fact: First spacecraft to land near the lunar south pole — the most contested territory in current space exploration, where permanently shadowed craters harbour water ice. Pragyan made the first in-situ detection of sulfur near the lunar south pole using its LIBS instrument. India became the fourth nation to soft-land on the Moon, and the first to reach the poles.
capability: Polar landing technique — Mars's south pole region (where seasonal water ice exists) becomes a destination only after the polar landing problem is solved on the Moon.
